summary: Bottom-up round 4. Reduced the n=6 three-minus amplitude to FOUR symmetric invariants (e1,e2,e3m,e3p) and used the minus/plus cubics to (1) PROVE the team's degree-9 denominator collapses on the manifold to a perfect cube of one cubic invariant, prod_{i,j}(omega_i+omega_j) = (omega_1 omega_2 omega_3 + omega_4 omega_5 omega_6)^3 = (e3m+e3p)^3; and (2) show the TRUE minimal denominator is that cubic to the FIRST power -- A_6 = i 2^5 g^-3 N/(e3m+e3p) with N a degree-11 spline (NOT degree 17). This corrects the PI-verified 'D9 minimal' claim (D9 over-clears by (e3m+e3p)^2). Also pinned the spline jump structure exactly: across (1=1) walls omega_i=omega_j the jump ~ (k_ij)^1 (first-derivative kink), across (1=2) walls omega_i^2=omega_j^2+omega_k^2 the jump ~ (k_ijk)^3 (cubic kink) -- different exponents, unlike n=5's uniform exponent 2. The closed form for the degree-11 numerator N remains open, but is now tightly constrained.
work_done: Proved D9 = prod_{i in {1,2,3}, j in {4,5,6}}(omega_i+omega_j) = (e3m+e3p)^3 on the manifold (Q(x)-p_-(x)=e3m+e3p constant => Q(omega_i)=e3m+e3p). Symbolic resultant + 8/8 random exact points (inv.py, verify_min_denom.py part P). Claim s1_011.

Showed the minimal denominator is (e3m+e3p)^1: A_6*(e3m+e3p) reconstructs to a pure-sumFree denominator (genuine 6-freq polynomial) on 8 slices across 4 chamber types; pole order of A_6 at e3m+e3p=0 is exactly 1 (verify_min_denom.py, pole_order2/3.py). N = A_6*(e3m+e3p)/(i2^5g^-3) has degree 11. Claim s1_012 (corrects s2_010/PI post_009).
Established the reduction to 4 invariants (e1,e2,e3m,e3p) via e1minus=-e1plus, e2minus=e2plus; Z_2 acts as (e1,e2,e3m,e3p)->(-e1,e2,e3p,e3m). Decision s1_dec_007.

Measured cross-wall jump orders on clean single-wall crossings (sign-diff=1): (1=1) wall -> jump order 1 in k_ij (C^0); (1=2) wall -> jump order 3 in k_ijk (C^2). Confirms team (1=2) 'cubic kink', pins both exponents; the split (1 vs 3) rules out a uniform-exponent box-spline for N. Identified the kink as living on the difference branch (omega_i-omega_j) (BG kernel |k_ij|=|omega_i-omega_j||omega_i+omega_j|). Claim s1_013, decision s1_dec_008.

Verified per-chamber N is a genuine degree-11 polynomial (pure-sumFree) but non-symmetric in legs (legs are cubic-root functions of the invariants), so only the GLOBAL N is invariant-valued (and a spline).
Noted all-n: Den_n = prod(omega_i+omega_j) = Res(p_-, Q_n); the perfect-cube collapse is special to n=6.
